meta.sources: ONS Census 2021 (Nomis bulk tables) · ONS 2021 boundaries · Food Standards Agency ratings · Gambling Commission register · © OpenStreetMap contributors (Nov 2026)
notes: People: Census 2021, counted on 21 March 2021 while England was still under COVID rules, so the census office warns that travel-to-work figures are unusual.
Areas: Brighton and Hove only, as the smaller LSOAs (about 1,700 people each) because the city has only about 37 MSOAs.
Pubs, restaurants and takeaways: Food Standards Agency hygiene-rating records (every food business councils inspect).
Betting shops, arcades and bingo: the Gambling Commission register, listed by postcode and placed at the postcode's centre.
Scotland is not included anywhere: it held its own census in 2022 with different tables.
Neighbourhood names: House of Commons Library MSOA Names (Open Parliament Licence), not official place names.

explain.the-hi-vis-line:
What does "hi-vis" mean?

Hi-vis is Australian slang for the bright, high-visibility vests worn on building sites, roads, warehouses and delivery routes.

Here it means driving, machine and labouring jobs, compared with managers and professionals. It describes jobs, not people.
